summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, reporting its second quarter financial results for the period ended June 27, 2026. The press release details quarterly net revenues of $3.49 billion, gross margin of 34.8%, and net income of $222 million ($0.24 diluted EPS), along with non-U.S. GAAP measures and a business outlook for Q3 2026. The filing is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. Management comments on demand trends and revenue ambitions for AI datacenters are provided. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or corporate action is disclosed. This is an ordinary periodic report for a foreign private issuer.
